mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_usage (service, day, calls, usd, remaining_usd, key_fingerprint) VALUES (#{service}, #{day}, #{calls}, #{usd}, #{remainingUsd}, #{keyFingerprint}) ON CONFLICT (service, day) DO UPDATE SET calls = api_usage.calls + EXCLUDED.calls, usd = api_usage.usd + EXCLUDED.usd, remaining_usd = CASE WHEN api_usage.key_fingerprint IS NOT DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.key_fingerprint THEN COALESCE(EXCLUDED.remaining_usd, api_usage.remaining_usd) ELSE EXCLUDED.remaining_usd END, key_fingerprint = EXCLUDED.key_fingerprint
mapper.select: INSERT INTO api_usage (service, day, calls, usd, remaining_usd, key_fingerprint) VALUES (#{service}, #{day}, GREATEST(#{delta}, 0), 0, NULL, 'none') ON CONFLICT (service, day) DO UPDATE SET calls = GREATEST(api_usage.calls + #{delta}, 0) RETURNING calls
SELECT service, day, calls, usd, remaining_usd, key_fingerprint FROM api_usage WHERE service = #{service} AND day = #{day}
SELECT service, day, calls, usd, remaining_usd, key_fingerprint FROM api_usage WHERE day = #{day} ORDER BY service
